title: CandidateBatchCompletedV1
description: CandidateBatchCompleted payload v1 (M2 step 10, 2026-11-08): one event per qualify batch (scoreCandidates page) per run. Machine candidates only — company refs and verdict distribution, no personal data. Consumers dedupe on the envelope event_id; the batch_ref is the stable business key for the batch.

run_ref.description: Temporal run id of the qualify workflow execution that produced this batch; null when the activity was invoked outside a workflow (tests/tools).

batch_no.description: Zero-based batch index within the run.

batch_ref.description: Stable batch key `qualify:<run_ref|direct>:<batch_no>`; also written to each lead's score_detail.candidateBatchRef.

scored.description: Candidates scored in this batch (companies quarantined by synthetic provenance are excluded).

candidates.description: Machine candidates in this batch (refs + machine verdict only; no PII).

lead_id.description: null only when the upsert did not return an id (defensive).
